The appointments reflect Colliers' continued focus on bringing together the strengths of its Mainland China and Hong Kong businesses to better support clients operating across local and international markets. Tang has led Colliers' Mainland China business for almost a decade, helping clients navigate change, strengthening market presence and driving growth in one of the world's most dynamic real estate markets. In her expanded role, Tang will provide strategic leadership across Mainland China and Hong Kong, helping clients capitalise on opportunities across the globe. Mainland China and Hong Kong are two of the most important markets in the global economy
